_note: A frozen set of scenarios and dimensions. Published numbers cite a suite.
The dataset grows over time. Without a pinned set, 'the score on RoboChrono'
would silently mean different things at different dates, and two such numbers
would look directly comparable when they are not.
When the dataset grows, add v2.json rather than editing this file.
Dimensions are pinned too: the cost is one line, and the risk of not pinning
them is that an added dimension quietly changes what v1 meant.
Suite and dataset are versioned separately: the suite counts published
frozen sets, the dataset counts releases of the data itself. v1 here is
the first frozen set, and it happens to be defined on dataset 2.0.
name: RoboChrono-v1
